overview: 完整 catalog／版本解析／pin／引用根生命週期一次確認候選；保留已驗收S1，不宣稱完整素材/GC/媒體模組完成。

architecture.intent: M05 owns project-scoped immutable material identity, verified versions, durable pins and derived reference manifests. It must resolve explicit references without losing versions used by documents/history/recovery.
architecture.hexagonal_view: Editor/Test → Tauri material commands → DispatchHost MaterialOwner → HOST AssetCatalog use cases → MaterialStorePort + existing FileCommitPort + authoritative RootProvider inputs. WORK S1 evaluate_asset_retention stays pure and unchanged. WindowsMaterialStore implements only new material storage interface.
architecture.dependency_view: M03 design facade/M04 single DocumentOwner → M05 application resolution/pin input port → HOST AssetCatalog. M04/M07/transaction owners → registered root-provider seam → M05 root projection → accepted WORK retention policy. UI never accesses adapter/store or supplies trusted roots.

owners.M05 MaterialOwner: Application per-project coordinator, authorization, provider epochs and project-store handle. No competing document state.
owners.M05 HOST: Catalog schema validation, resolve/pin/transfer/index transition rules.
owners.M05 adapter: Safe immutable blob publication/read and store identity; journal semantics delegated to existing FileCommit adapter for index only.
owners.M04 DocumentOwner: Sole S1 document session, content/history/revisions and captured save evidence.
owners.M03: Candidate binding/Viewer projections through M04 owner; not catalog owner.
owners.M07: Recovery payload/index publication proof; not implemented by this package.
owners.WORK S1: Retain/eligible decision only; eligibility still not deletion authority.

architecture.mutation: Only MaterialOwner invokes catalog transitions under project catalog lease; only corresponding document owner invokes S1 content commit. Resolution is read-only; durable pin acquisition is a separate explicit operation.
architecture.transactions: One catalog index is the atomic metadata boundary. Blob publication precedes index publication. Document bytes and catalog index are NOT one atomic transaction; durable pins bridge gaps. Never promise rollback of a committed document when pin promotion fails.
architecture.cross_process: Each index transition holds existing FileCommitPort acquire_write on catalog path; adapter handles OS exclusion/journal inspection. Lease+CAS protect catalog across processes. Immutable blob publication is create-if-absent and verify existing digest; no overwrite/remove API. Process-local mutex alone insufficient.
forbidden: M05 mutates M04 content or ACK
M04 uses catalog raw hash as semantic baseline
reuse S1 eligibility as physical delete grant
manual writes to IO private journal
architecture.approval: PROPOSED; diagrams and new Ports await Owner. New adapter scope requires explicit approval, not inherited IO approval.

schema.storage: Project-owned .sgenaxis/materials/catalog.v1.json; immutable objects .sgenaxis/materials/objects/<lowerhex SHA256>.blob. OS adapter binds project/store directory handle identities, not UI strings. These paths are new proposal, not IO private journal paths.

catalog_fields.generation: u64; initial0; each effective index commit checked+1

asset_record.legacy_aliases: exact UTF8 strings registered by trusted project migration only; unique within project, never auto-trim/casefold/path interpretation

version_record.digest: lowerhex64 SHA256 exact blob bytes; identity=(asset_id,digest)
version_record.media_type: opaque declared MIME ASCII1..128bytes; not proof of decoder support
version_record.status: Published only; staged objects never visible in index

pin_record.state: Held|Transferred; only Held keeps temporary ownership
pin_record.transfer_receipt: optional immutable target root IDs+receipt digest

root_manifest.kind: one of accepted S1 five RootKind values
root_manifest.source_revision: opaque producer revision, not numeric ordered across owners
root_manifest.evidence: Opaque owner-authenticated receipt/file/capture attestation; UI cannot issue

schema.operation_record: {operation_id, caller_binding, input_digest, result_kind, receipt_digest, generation}; immutable replay record. Results include Published|Pinned|Transferred|Released. Same ID/different digest conflicts. No eviction/restart forgetfulness.
schema.canonical_index: UTF8 compact JSON, schema field order as above; record fields fixed in declared order; all arrays sorted by ID UTF8 bytes (versions by digest; root references by asset_id,digest,owner_id). Reject unknown/duplicate fields, wrong types, floats for integer fields, invalid UTF8/BOM/NUL IDs, digest mismatch; no ignored fields. Strict raw parse before typed decode. Index raw SHA used only CAS, never M03/M04 semantic digest.
schema.counting: All limits inclusive; lengths UTF8 bytes, no character-count substitution. Request count checked before dedup; persisted total checked after exact dedup. Index output bytes checked by counting writer before commit. All new bounds are Owner choices. Saturation fails before mutating index; no implicit removal, pin expiry or GC.

application_inputs.resolve: resolve(context: ResolutionContext, requests: ReferenceRequest[]) -> ResolutionSnapshot | MaterialError
application_inputs.pin: pin(context, snapshot, purpose, operation_id) -> PinReceipt | MaterialError
application_inputs.transfer: transfer(context, pin_id, authoritative_root_manifest, commit_proof, operation_id) -> TransferReceipt | MaterialError
application_inputs.release: release(context, pin_id, root_bundle, operation_id) -> ReleaseReceipt | MaterialError
application_inputs.import: import(context, opaque_selection_id, declared_media_type, operation_id) -> PublishedVersion | MaterialError

ports.ResolutionContext: {project_uuid,document_uuid,session_uuid,owner_generation:u64,captured_revision:u64,caller_binding}; authenticated by MaterialOwner, not Tauri user fields.
ports.ReferenceRequest: {source_path,kind:Asset|Binding,opaque_id,pinned_digest?:lowerhex64,target_id?:string}; exact M04 proposed shape. Require explicit pinned version for execution/save; trusted legacy map may supply sole explicit pinned pair, never latest/head fallback.
ports.ResolutionSnapshot: Echo context + catalog_generation + catalog_raw_digest + completeness Complete + assets[] + bindings[] + snapshot_digest; no pin is implied. Catalog revalidated at pin transition; stale snapshot fails, caller requests fresh resolve.
ports.MaterialStorePort: bind_store(trusted_project_selection: opaque token) -> StoreHandle; StoreHandle.inspect_identity() -> StoreIdentity; StoreHandle.index_target() -> opaque authorized path string for FileCommitPort; StoreHandle.import_blob(trusted_source_selection, max_bytes) -> BlobReceipt; StoreHandle.verify_blob(digest, expected_size) -> VerifiedBlob; no remove, overwrite, repair or arbitrary read API.
ports.BlobReceipt: {store_identity,digest,size_bytes,publication:Created|VerifiedExisting}; success requires full bytes hash, safe native handle, flushed blob and durable directory entry. Existing digest with different size/bytes/corrupt object is IntegrityFailure, never replaced.
ports.RootProviderPort: observe(registration, expected_epoch) -> RootManifest; fence(producer_revision) -> RootFence token; validate(fence) -> Current|Changed|Unknown. Ownership-specific facade implements it; no arbitrary external callback dispatched from UI.
ports.composition: HOST depends abstractions; Tauri constructs WindowsMaterialStore + existing FileCommit adapter. New sgenaxis-ports material_store.rs contains storage data/trait; application contracts in HOST asset_store.rs. Existing FileCommitPort public signatures unchanged.
ports.native_safety: All store/source/objects handles identity-bound; reject reparse/8.3/hardlink identity ambiguity and path escape, unexpected link count, nonregular objects, sharing violations. Never trust lexical containment alone. Native adapter capabilities must be tested on Windows11 x64 before readiness. Other OS UnsupportedPlatform.
ports.clock_ids: IDs minted by application injected opaque ID source; collisions checked under lease; no timestamp uniqueness assumption. No automatic expiration; monotonic clock only for UI preview optional, never pin release.

import: Authorize project+source selection; verify store identity; acquire catalog lease; strict read+validate index and raw digest (missing index permitted only explicit initialization).

Stream selected source through safe immutable-blob adapter; reject empty/>64MiB; exact digest. No decoder execution, SVG fetching, script execution or MIME-based execution. Media rendering format support remains separate.
Publish new immutable object durably; adapter verifies existing object if hash already exists. Until index commit it is unreachable orphan, never user-visible Published.
Construct AssetRecord/version plus durable Import pin and operation replay record in one next index; generation+1; validate all capacities/output bytes; replace_checked previous raw digest.

Verify CommitReceipt target/previous/new digest and transaction_id; PublishedVersion contains receipt+pin. Failure before index commit leaves old index; orphan retained. Commit uncertain blocks catalog mutations and preserves blob evidence; never delete orphan as rollback.
transactions.resolve_pin: Resolve names from validated current index; verify every referenced blob identity/hash/size and all target binding evidence. Obtain complete snapshot. Pin takes exclusive index lease; exact snapshot generation/raw hash check then persist Held pin+operation in next index. Durable pin receipt only after verified index commit. Any concurrent index update yields StaleCatalog (caller may explicitly resolve again); no silent latest-version change.
transactions.candidate_install: M03 candidate → M04 validated candidate/expected revision → M05 resolve+pin Candidate → owner rechecks generation/revision and pin validity → one existing S1 commit. Before content commit failure may request release; after commit publish LiveDocuments/Undo/Redo root observations then transfer pin. If root publication fails, content remains installed with Held pin; report InstalledRetentionDeferred, block later destructive retention actions; no fake rollback.
transactions.formal_save: M04 capture includes exact asset set, semantic profile/digest and encoded bytes; resolve+Save pin before FileCommit replace. File receipt verified by M04. M05 transfer Save pin to durable formal-document root manifest only with matching captured identity, reference set, semantic profile/digest and receipt target/previous/new digest+transaction ID. Then M04 may ACK captured semantic. Promotion failure after file commit => CommittedAckDeferred with Held pin and both proofs; no retry of file write, no forced clean.
transactions.save_proof: CommitEvidence {project,document,session,generation,captured_revision,semantic_profile,semantic_digest,raw_encoded_digest,previous_raw_digest?,target_identity,transaction_id,pin_id,versions_digest}. M05 authenticates originating owner and exact pin/versions/context; it does not independently certify arbitrary receipt or update document baseline.
transactions.undo_redo: M04 publishes complete union roots for live/Undo/Redo atomically in one catalog transition; old roots retained until new root set durable. Undo never deletes bytes. S1 before+after required asset pairs remain unchanged. If publication fails keep previous roots +Held candidate pin; unknown/new roots conservatively retain.
transactions.recovery: M07 must pin before payload publication, then transfer only after payload+index receipt confirmed. Snapshot removal does not release pin without updated complete root manifest/fence. No real scheduler/recovery writer implemented here; unavailable M07 provider remains Unknown.
transactions.release: Check exact pin owner/purpose and generation, all five root-provider observations present, Complete and current under fences. If any unknown/stale/registered provider missing => Retained{reasons}, no removal. Otherwise update only temporary pin metadata to Released via index transition; asset records/blobs remain. Referenced versions remain protected by root manifests. No physical deletion or automatic orphan sweep in this slice.
transactions.crash: Published durable Held pins survive restart. Partial blob import may leave unindexed/temp object; retain for explicit future reconciliation. Journal RecoveryRequired/mismatched receipt => project MaterialRecoveryBlocked; no new root trust/import/release. Existing catalog inspect read may expose diagnostics, never execute unverified references. Recovery/repair new transaction is separate proposal.
transactions.replay: operation_id1..128ASCII bound to authenticated caller and hash of exact canonical request. Identical completed request returns stored result/proof; different body ReplayConflict. Index uncertain => PendingRecovery, not a retry. IDs remain persisted (8192 cap), no silent eviction. Durable operation receipt lookup rechecks project/role; revoked caller denied.
transactions.cross_index_limit: No simultaneous durable atomic commit across catalog and document/snapshot. Pins make intermediate states safe by retention, not by pretending multi-file atomicity. Reconciliation can promote retained pins from verified evidence later; never fabricate a successful ACK.

roots_lifecycle.LiveDocuments: Includes all current document owners AND persisted formal-document version manifests in authorized project, including closed documents. Provider must attest complete project coverage; current-window scan insufficient. Missing persisted-document inventory => Unknown. Durable manifests are derived receipts, not alternate editable content.
roots_lifecycle.registration: MaterialOwner registers provider IDs, scope and epoch from trusted composition. Need every registered provider for each kind; aggregating all providers yields one S1 RootObservation per kind. Any missing/incomplete component makes kind Unknown. Never omit unready M07 merely to claim completeness.
roots_lifecycle.epochs: Project switch/window detach invalidates registration epoch. Old proof cannot replace new epoch. Closing a session first publishes retained history/formal roots or marks Unknown; dropping memory is not root deletion proof.
roots_lifecycle.freshness: Freeze all relevant producer revisions via RootFence; if any producer cannot fence, retention/release returns Retained Unknown. Do not hold catalog lock while calling providers: collect fences first, acquire lease then validate all fences. Never wait for document lock while holding catalog lock. Owner pins before adding refs, root transitions only after pin receipt.
roots_lifecycle.s1_mapping: Exactly five aggregated observations and expected revisions supplied to accepted evaluate_asset_retention; use completeness Unknown on any provider gap. Do not add enum variants, relax validation or alter S1 test expectations. S1 EligibleForCleanup still only eligibility.
roots_lifecycle.pin_lifecycle: Unindexed staging → durable Held (before external content references) → Transferred (new root manifests committed in same catalog index) OR safe Released. Owner loss/crash/timeout never releases Held. Replayed transfer verifies immutable original proof and returns same transfer receipt. No wall-clock TTL.
roots_lifecycle.physical_gc: DEFERRED_SEPARATE_ENVELOPE. Needs native deletion fence, recovery and complete inventory; no remove method, no delete command, no reclaimed-byte claim. Catalog retention capacity/full disk risks surfaced without weakening safety.

binding_save_integration.M03: Reference extractor supplied by adopted C1/H2 validates supported fields; Editor selection/Viewer mock is ephemeral and creates no asset pin/root. Viewer cannot import/pin/release/mutate roots. Binding state changes persisted only as explicit document content edit through M04 owner.
binding_save_integration.legacy: M04 exact XML assetRef text maps through explicit trusted catalog legacy_aliases to immutable pair. Migration registration requires owner-confirmed mapping with digest; no trim or filename/path auto-resolution. Ambiguous/missing alias fails UnmappedReference. Unknown props never guessed.
binding_save_integration.targets: Internal target IDs checked against candidate entity set; external target requires trusted binding provider evidence echoing project/document/revision. Valid target absent => MissingTarget; explicitly authored Pending is preserved and blocks execute/build while edit/save allowed only assets fully pinned. Invalid/unknown binding blocks install/save. Duplicate binding ID error, never dedup losing behavior.
joint_amendments: M04-S2 material resolve contract gains durable pin/transfer receipts and pin validation, not just snapshot catalog revision.
M04-S2 formal ACK ordering amended: valid file receipt → M05 root transfer receipt → semantic ACK. Failure returns CommittedAckDeferred.
M03-H2 candidate success distinguishes InstalledRetentionDeferred from failure when document already committed. No second session registry.
M03/M04 SGA-DESIGN-SEM-v1 pending shared profile is carried unchanged, not recomputed by M05. M05 raw catalog hash is a different domain.
binding_save_integration.authorization: These are proposed coordinated amendments to pending packets; original files/revisions remain frozen. Adoption of M05 alone cannot silently amend M03/M04 or authorize their implementations.

errors.result: Tagged Result<Success,MaterialError>; success/error mutually exclusive. Deferred external-commit result explicitly carries document/catalog receipts; cannot report unchanged failure.
errors.shape: MaterialError {code,stage,path,reason,operation_id?,details}; path is JSON pointer or opaque source_path; unauthorized callers receive no OS paths/blob contents.
errors.precedence: caller/project authorization → closed DTO/type/UTF8/count prechecks → store identity → catalog lease/read/journal → strict schema/input guards in JSON encounter order → request replay → generation/capacity → exact resolution/binding → blob verification → root freshness/pin ownership → proposed index output checks → index IO receipt verification. First failing stage wins; no extra IO after error.
errors.error_detail: CommitError variant fields preserved exactly, including RecoveryRequired target/journal/old/new paths and reason. Blob errors stage=SourceOpen|Copy|Hash|Flush|Publish|Verify. Catalog Resource includes token,limit,observed,path; root path /. Per-array error points /assets/i etc in input encounter order; normalized sorting only after validation.
errors.failure_policy: Before index commit: previous valid index remains; orphan blob may remain. After verified index commit: Published/Pinned receipt survives response loss. Uncertain commit: retain all evidence and block; never claim old index unchanged. No automatic retry, expiry, repair or physical deletion.

ui.internal_only: resolve/pin/transfer/release/publish_roots and legacy alias registration are application ports, NOT Tauri arbitrary invoke commands. No Viewer or automation grant inherited from label.
ui.schema: Editor material panel shows immutable asset/version/digest, verification status, pin/root reasons and pending proof. Import disabled without trusted source/project binding or blocked store; failed import preserves existing list. No delete/cleanup button in this slice. Paging max100 records, cursor server-issued bound to catalog generation; stale cursor StaleCatalog.
ui.a11y: Keyboard import/select version; status aria-live; failure preserves selection, details access restricted; pending is never success icon.
ui.media_scope: Opaque bytes catalog/import support does not imply PNG/JPEG/SVG/video decode/render safety or broad media matrix adoption. Viewer active content, executable SVG and remote references remain prohibited; separate approved renderer validates before preview.

decisions.proposal: Adopt catalog schema, bounds and immutable explicit version/alias identity; raw catalog hash distinct from semantic fingerprints.
Adopt MaterialStorePort and Windows adapter +existing FileCommit index transaction; no generic FS bypass or IO journal change.
Adopt durable pin-before-reference and receipt-bearing transfer/release with no timeout expiry.
Adopt all five provider aggregation/epoch/fence lifecycle, persisted formal-document roots and Unknown conservative behavior; preserve accepted S1.
Adopt proposed M03/M04 amendments for candidate deferred retention and save promotion-before-ACK, explicit binding projector contract.
Adopt no physical GC/repair/automatic media execution in this slice; retain requirements as separate tasks, not module-complete.
Adopt closed UI/internal ACL, error/replay/capacity policies and exact candidate envelope/test gates.
